instruction: Locate resources about how to register a vehicle.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the agent to navigate to the vehicle registration services page on Virginia DMV website. The evaluator uses the existing is_expected_active_tab metric to check if the URL matches the vehicles section. This is similar to the original task in terms of difficulty (single-page navigation on same website). No custom functions needed as we use existing evaluator functions.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if URL exactly matches the vehicles page, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: finding information about vehicle registration services is verified by checking if the user navigated to the /vehicles page on Virginia DMV website
Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree by reading the Chrome address bar entry
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab compares the actual URL with the expected URL using the compare_urls utility function
Expected value is semantically correct: https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/vehicles is the correct page for vehicle registration services on the Virginia DMV website
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL → metric compares with expected → returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
The goto_prefix configuration ('https://www.') correctly constructs the full URL to match the expected format
Edge cases are handled: the getter supports both ARM (Chromium) and x86 (Google Chrome) architectures
